Mistweaver Monk Healing Best Gems, Enchants, and Consumables — Midnight (12.0.1)

Last updated on Mar 05, 2026 at 05:19 by Dhaubbs 48 comments
General Information

On this page, we list the best gems, enchants, flasks, potions, and food you can get for your Mistweaver Monk, based on your stat priority. We also give budget alternatives. This page is updated for World of Warcraft — Midnight (12.0.1).

1.

Best Gems, Enchants, Food, and Flasks for Mistweaver Monk in Midnight

This section specifically covers the optimal gems, enchants, food, and flasks to use for your character. To get a more detailed rundown of the different stats for Mistweaver Monk, please visit our dedicated Stats page.

Mistweaver Monk Stat Priority
2.

Gems for Mistweaver Monk in Midnight

We highly recommend using QuestionablyEpic to sim your character's ideal gems and enchants, as they might differ from our general recommendations.

2.1.

Raiding

The best stats for Raiding Mistweaver Monks are Haste and Crit, so that is what we will be gemming for.

You should use Indecipherable Eversong Diamond in one socket, then fill the rest of your sockets with Flawless Deadly Peridots.

2.2.

Mythic+

The best stats for Mythic+ Mistweaver Monks are still likely Haste and Crit but can change depending on your goals. Haste will always be ideal to stack until you hit diminishing returns, but depending on your playstyle, you can opt to choose Crit, Mastery, or Vers as your second stat to stack.

Most of the time, you should use Indecipherable Eversong Diamond in one socket then fill the rest with Flawless Deadly Peridots. However if you are finding that you are comfortable on your haste and want a tiny bit more tankiness, you can opt for Flawless Quick Lapis instead. That being said, you will probably get better mileage by just sticking with the Peridots.

3.

4.

Best Consumables for Mistweaver Monk in Midnight

Consumables substantially increase the power of your character for a limited time. Any time you are challenging yourself with difficult content, it is advisable that you buff yourself with Flasks, Food, Potions, and Weapon Oils.

4.1.

Flasks

For most content Flask of the Blood Knights will be your standard choice, as it provides our strongest throughput stat. In Mythic+, there may be times in which you find that the extra Versatility from Flask of Thalassian Resistance is more beneficial in order to leverage the slight damage reduction.

4.2.

Foods

For optimal throughput, you should be using Silvermoon Parade/ Harandar Celebration in order to gain primary stat. However, if these feasts are unavailable to you (as they can be cost prohibitive) then you should make use of Royal Roast. The secondary stat it provides is weaker than the Intellect you would gain from a feast, but it is much more affordable.

4.3.

Potions and Weapon Oils

Mistweavers generally have three options for potions: Potion of Devoured Dreams for maximal mana return, Lightfused Mana Potion for immediate mana return, and Light's Potential for throughput. Generally, in raids you will be using Potion of Devoured Dreams and in Mythic+ you will be using Lightfused Mana Potion, but it is a good idea to carry a stock of all three in order to use whichever is best in the moment.

The best Weapon Oil for Mistweavers is Thalassian Phoenix Oil as it buffs both of our strongest secondary stats.
